jobs.name: creative-1-sticky-notes-v4
jobs.prompt:
Direct-response ad image for the Meta feed, 4:5. Reproduce the provided brand logo exactly where specified, never redraw it.

SCENE: a PTE aspirant's study desk at night, photographed from the front at slight elevation. An open laptop sits lower-right, its screen showing a softly blurred practice-test interface that casts a cool glow; a wired headset with microphone — the PTE test headset — rests on the keyboard. A warm desk lamp lights the scene from the right. The wall above the desk holds the ad's text and notes. Mood: the 11pm practice grind, real and lived-in — a mug, a pen, nothing staged.

THE NOTES: five sticky notes with slightly curled corners — three stuck on the wall above the laptop in a loose cluster, one stuck on the laptop's screen bezel edge, one on the wall lower, half-lit by the lamp. Pastel colors (mint, orange, blue, yellow, pink), handwritten in blue ballpoint, natural uneven handwriting, one short phrase per note, each phrase complete on its note, exactly: "Speaking 58" · "Retake #3" · "Good English, low score" · "Templates don't work" · "Exam in 2 weeks".

TYPE ON THE WALL AREA (designed type over the dim wall, cream-white for contrast): small gold-outlined rounded chip, uppercase, exactly: "LIVE PTE MASTERCLASS · SAT 11 JULY · 4 HOURS". Below it the headline in a heavy geometric sans, 800 weight, sentence case, cream-white, set LARGE in exactly three stacked lines — "Are these" / "keeping you" / "under 79?" — each line with a cap height of about 7 percent of the image height, the headline block dominating the left half of the frame, exactly: "Are these keeping you under 79?" Under it at half the headline size, regular weight, exactly: "One Saturday. The format, decoded." One plain line beneath, clearly readable at feed size (about 2.5 percent of image height), exactly: "4.9★ · 491 Google reviews · Pearson-certified trainer". Bottom-left, a rounded-rectangle CTA band in solid warm yellow with navy bold text, exactly: "Claim your seat → ₹589". The brand logo sits small at top-left on the wall.

LIGHT & FINISH: two light sources only — warm lamp from the right, cool screen glow from below-left; soft real shadows under each note and behind the laptop; photographed-real textures throughout (wall grain, worn desk wood); the designed type floats clean above the scene. The only saturated elements are the yellow CTA and the notes.

PALETTE: warm dark evening tones, cream-white type, navy shadows, one yellow accent.

RENDER EXACTLY the quoted text strings and no other text, no people, no watermarks.
